name: io.github.community/security-review-slash
description: Slash command /security-review: OWASP Top 10 + SANS CWE security audit of changed code. Flags injection, XSS, auth, secrets, and supply-chain risks.

claude-code.commandBody:
---
description: OWASP Top 10 + SANS CWE security audit of the pending diff or specified files.
---

Perform a security review of the following code/diff:

$ARGUMENTS

Audit against:
- **OWASP Top 10** (A01 Broken Access Control through A10 SSRF)
- **SANS CWE Top 25** (injection, path traversal, memory safety, etc.)
- **Secrets / credentials** hardcoded or logged
- **Dependency risks** (unpinned versions, known CVEs)
- **Supply chain** (eval, dynamic require, shell injection)

Format each finding as:
```
[SEVERITY] CWE-XXX — Short title
File: path/to/file.ext:line
Issue: what's wrong
Fix: specific remediation
```

Severities: CRITICAL / HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW / INFO
End with a summary table.
